01

Introduction

Welcome to Habit Tracker ("the App", "we", "us", or "our").

This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, protect, and delete information when you use Habit Tracker.

We are committed to protecting your privacy and handling your information responsibly. We collect and use information only as necessary to provide and improve the features of Habit Tracker.

By using Habit Tracker, you acknowledge the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

02

Information We Handle

Depending on the features you use, Habit Tracker may handle the following categories of information.

2.1 Habit and App Data

The App may store information that you create within Habit Tracker, such as:

  • Habit names and descriptions
  • Habit schedules and selected days
  • Habit completion records
  • Reminder settings
  • Habit tracking history
  • App preferences and settings
  • Other information you voluntarily enter into the App

This information is used to provide the habit-tracking functionality of the App.

2.2 Google Account Information

If you choose to connect your Google Account, we may receive limited information necessary to authenticate you and provide Google-related features.

Depending on the permissions you grant, this may include information such as:

  • Google account identifier
  • Name or profile information provided through Google authentication
  • Email address, where required for authentication or account functionality
  • Authorization information required to access the Google service you have approved

We do not request access to Google information that is not necessary for the functionality you choose to use.

2.3 Google Drive Data

If you choose to enable Google Drive backup, Habit Tracker may access and manage the application data or files necessary to provide the backup and restore functionality.

Your habit data may be stored in your connected Google Drive account for backup purposes.

Habit Tracker uses Google Drive only to provide the backup and restore functionality described in the App.

  • We do not sell your Google Drive data.
  • We do not use Google Drive data for advertising.
  • We do not use Google Drive data for purposes unrelated to providing the features of Habit Tracker.
  • We do not allow third parties to use your Google Drive data for their own advertising or marketing purposes.

2.4 Device and Technical Information

The App or third-party services used by the App may process limited technical information necessary to operate, secure, and troubleshoot the App. Depending on the services and SDKs included in the current version of the App, this may include:

  • Device type
  • Operating system and version
  • App version
  • Technical diagnostics
  • Crash or error information

We do not intentionally collect precise location information unless a future version of the App specifically requires it and provides the appropriate disclosure and permission request.

03

How We Use Information

Information handled by Habit Tracker may be used to:

  • Provide habit tracking functionality
  • Save and restore your habit data
  • Provide reminders and app functionality
  • Authenticate your Google Account when you choose to use Google authentication
  • Provide Google Drive backup and restore functionality
  • Maintain and improve the App
  • Diagnose technical problems
  • Protect the security and integrity of the App
  • Comply with applicable legal requirements

We do not sell personal information.

We do not use your habit data or Google Drive data for targeted advertising.

04

Google Services

Habit Tracker may use Google services, including Google Sign-In and Google Drive APIs, to provide authentication and backup functionality.

When you authorize Google services, information is handled according to the permissions you approve and the applicable Google policies.

Google user data accessed through Google APIs is used only for the purposes disclosed in this Privacy Policy and within the functionality provided by Habit Tracker.

For more information about how Google handles information, please refer to Google's applicable privacy and service policies.

05

Data Sharing

We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information.

We may share or disclose information only when reasonably necessary to:

  • Provide functionality through service providers or technical infrastructure;
  • Protect the security of the App;
  • Prevent fraud, abuse, or unauthorized activity;
  • Comply with applicable laws, regulations, or legal processes; or
  • Protect our legal rights.

Third-party service providers are expected to process information only for legitimate purposes related to providing their services. Google services are governed by Google's applicable terms and policies.

06

Data Storage and Security

We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect information against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, alteration, or disclosure.

Where information is transmitted over networks, appropriate security measures such as encrypted communication may be used.

Your Google Drive backup remains associated with the Google Account and Drive environment you authorize.

However, no method of electronic storage or transmission can be guaranteed to be completely secure. Therefore, we cannot guarantee absolute security of information.

07

Data Retention

We retain information only for as long as reasonably necessary to provide the App's functionality, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, enforce agreements, and maintain security.

Data stored in your Google Drive through the backup feature may remain in your Google Drive until you delete it or disconnect/remove the relevant backup data.

If you delete your Habit Tracker account or request deletion of your personal data, we will delete the applicable data under our control, subject to information that we are legally required or permitted to retain.

08

Data Deletion

You may request deletion of your Habit Tracker account and associated personal data.

If the App provides an account deletion feature, you may initiate deletion directly through the App.

If you cannot access the App, you may request deletion using the contact method provided below.

Where applicable, deleting your Habit Tracker account does not automatically delete copies of data that you have independently stored in your Google Drive. You may need to delete such backup data from Google Drive separately.

We will process valid deletion requests within a reasonable period, subject to applicable legal requirements.

09

Disconnecting Google Drive

You may stop using Google Drive backup by disconnecting your Google Account from Habit Tracker.

Disconnecting access may prevent future backup and restore operations.

Disconnecting Habit Tracker from Google Drive does not necessarily delete previously created backup data from your Google Drive. If you want that data removed, you should delete the relevant backup data from your Google Drive or use any deletion functionality provided by Habit Tracker.

10

Children's Privacy

Habit Tracker is not intended to knowingly collect personal information from children in violation of applicable laws.

If you believe that a child has provided personal information to us in a manner that violates applicable requirements, please contact us so that we can take appropriate action.

11

Third-Party Services

Habit Tracker may use third-party services necessary to operate, secure, authenticate, distribute, or improve the App.

Such services may include Google services and other technical service providers used by the App.

Each third-party service may process information according to its own terms and privacy policies.

We do not permit third-party services to use personal information for purposes that are inconsistent with this Privacy Policy or applicable law.

12

Your Choices

Depending on the features available in the App, you may:

  • Choose whether to connect Google services;
  • Choose whether to use Google Drive backup;
  • Disconnect Google services;
  • Delete your Habit Tracker account;
  • Request deletion of applicable personal data;
  • Delete backup data stored in your own Google Drive.
13

Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy when the App's functionality, data practices, or legal requirements change.

When we make material changes, we will provide appropriate notice within the App or through another reasonable method.

The "Last Updated" date at the beginning of this Privacy Policy indicates when the policy was most recently updated.
